## MiniMax Music 2.5 API

MiniMax Music 2.5 is a music generation model by MiniMax, available on the Venice API as `minimax-music-v25`. Requests are anonymized, so the provider never sees your identity.

Advanced song generation with vocals, lyrics optimizer, and instrumental mode. Supports structure tags and up to 3500 character lyrics.

### MiniMax Music 2.5 API pricing

| Model ID | Variant | Privacy | Price |
|---|---|---|---|
| `minimax-music-v25` | Standard | Anonymized | $0.18 / track |

### MiniMax Music 2.5 specifications

| Spec | Value |
|---|---|
| Provider | MiniMax |
| Released | Apr 12, 2026 |
| Privacy | Anonymized |
| Status | Stable |

### How to use the MiniMax Music 2.5 API

Send requests to `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue` with `"model": "minimax-music-v25"` and your API key.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "minimax-music-v25",
    "prompt": "Warm lo-fi hip hop beat with soft piano and vinyl crackle"
  }'

# 2. Retrieve when ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/audio/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "minimax-music-v25", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output audio.mp3
```
